Message: The Hero...did not awaken.

That’s strange.
I made sure to properly
put him inside the body too.

Ah...! The shapes mustn’t
have matched well enough.

The relationship between body
and spirit is delicate, after all.
I have to tailor to
each of them properly.

Now then, I’ll just
scrape away some of
the Hero’s spirit.

“You there.
Do you even understand
what is coming out of
your mouth?”

In order to save the Hero,
I’m going to scrape away
some of his spirit.
Is there something
wrong with that?
“...All I can do is warn you,

but if you change
the shape of a spirit,
it will never go back
to how it was.

Anything that is precious
must be treated as such.”

Your gracious warning is
more than appreciated,
Your Majesty.
Now then, I’ll get
started right away.
—Please...!

...? What was that
voice just now?
It brought back some
happy memories...
filled with warmth...

Well, no matter.
I have to hurry and
scrape away
the Hero’s spirit.

...Scrape away?
The Hero’s spirit?

Why...? There’s no way
I’d do something
so horrifying...!
Just what am I trying to...?

“You should be grateful
for your friend.”

“A heart that cares for others can,
at times, bring about a miracle.

One that brings warmth
to the hearts of people.
Through the fine thread
called a bond,

your friend’s truly meager power
was able to restore a small
portion of your fractured spirit.”

...How long has it been?
Since when...
have I become like this...?
Like this...?!

I have to scrape them away.
I have to hurry and scrape away...
every last one of these feelings...!
